missing_document.title: {requirement} is not on file
missing_document.detail: Accepted documents: {accepts}. This has to come from the applicant.

name_mismatch.title: The name on the {docType} does not match
name_mismatch.detail: Aadhaar reads “{referenceName}” while the {docType} reads “{nameOnDocument}”. Even compared across both scripts, the agreement is only {score}.

name_variation.title: Small difference in the name on the {docType}
name_variation.detail: Aadhaar reads “{referenceName}” and the {docType} reads “{nameOnDocument}”. The spelling differs but it sounds the same. Confirm on the visit.

address_outside_village.title: The address on the {docType} is not in the village
address_outside_village.detail: The application says {village}, but the address on the {docType} is “{addressOnDocument}”.

income_above_declared.title: The income on the {docType} is above the declared income
income_above_declared.detail: The {docType} works out to {documentIncome} a year against the {declaredIncome} declared ({gapPercent}). One month's slip is a poor guide to a whole year, so settle this on the field visit.

land_income_doubt.title: The land holding suggests a higher income
land_income_doubt.detail: The 7/12 extract shows {areaHectares} ha of {kind} land, which works out to roughly {estimatedIncome} a year against the {declaredIncome} declared. This is a rough estimate, so check the actual crop and yield on the visit.

labour_no_income_proof.title: Daily-wage work leaves no documentary proof of income
labour_no_income_proof.detail: There is no salary slip or return to cross-check in this occupation, so the income has to be established on the field visit. This is not a defect in the file.

findingSms.name_mismatch: The name on the {docType} ({nameOnDocument}) does not match Aadhaar.
findingSms.address_outside_village: The address on the {docType} is not in {village}.

reason.return_for_documents: {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} can be cleared by the applicant, so returning the file now is the cheap option. Returning it after a field visit means another trip for the citizen.
reason.documents_in_order: Every required document is on file and the names and address agree. The income will be established on the field visit.
reason.settle_on_visit: What was found cannot be cleared by asking the applicant for another paper; it will be settled on the field visit.
reason.visit_complete: Everything on the visit list is recorded and the income agrees with the declaration.
reason.findings_for_officer: The visit turned up {notes, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}. Send them on with the report; the Naib Tehsildar decides.
reason.not_a_resident: The field visit found that the applicant does not live in {village}. Residence is not established, so a certificate cannot be issued.
reason.revised_declaration_needed: The verified income of {verifiedIncome} is {gapPercent} above what was declared. It would be right to take a revised self-declaration from the applicant.
reason.all_checks_passed: Documents complete, residence established, and the verified income agrees with the declaration.
reason.approve_with_notes: The file can be approved, with {against, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} to note.

point.documents_complete: All {count} required documents are on file.
point.documents_incomplete: {count, plural, one {# required document is} other {# required documents are}} still missing.
point.residence_confirmed: The field visit confirmed that the applicant lives in {village}.
point.residence_not_confirmed: The field visit did not establish residence at the stated address.
point.income_verified_matches: The verified income of {verifiedIncome} agrees with the declaration ({gapPercent}).
point.income_gap: The verified income is {verifiedIncome} against {declaredIncome} declared ({gapPercent}).
point.field_report_on_file: The Talathi's panchnama is on file.
point.overdue: The application is {days} days past the service deadline.
point.open_finding: The scrutiny finding “{finding}” has not been settled.

visitItem.confirm_residence: Call at the house and confirm that the applicant lives in {village}.
visitItem.confirm_family_size: Check how many people are in the family. The application says {declared}.
visitItem.inspect_land: Inspect the {areaHectares} ha holding; note the crop and whether it is irrigated.
visitItem.confirm_employment: Check where the applicant works and what they are paid now.
visitItem.visit_business: Call at the business and form a view of the turnover.
visitItem.ask_wage_pattern: Ask how many days a year the work comes and at what daily rate.
visitItem.ask_about_document_income: Ask the applicant about the {documentIncome} shown on the {docType}.
visitItem.ask_about_land_yield: {areaHectares} ha works out to roughly {estimatedIncome}; record what the land actually yields.
visitItem.confirm_identity: Confirm before the panch witnesses that “{nameOnDocument}” is the same person.
visitItem.confirm_address: Ask about the address “{addressOnDocument}” shown on the document.
visitItem.ask_other_earners: Ask about the income of anyone else in the family who earns.
visitItem.note_assets: Note the house, vehicle, land and any other property.
visitItem.record_panch: Take the names and signatures of at least two local panch witnesses.

income.field_income_matches: The verified income agrees with the declaration ({gapPercent}).
income.field_income_above_declared: The verified income is {gapPercent} above the declared income.
income.field_income_below_declared: The verified income is {gapPercent} below the declared income.

certificate.title: Income Certificate
certificate.notApproved: This application was not approved, so there is no certificate.
certificate.body:
This is to certify that the total annual income of {applicantName}, resident of {village}, Taluka {taluka}, District {district}, and family ({familyMembers} members in all), from all sources in the previous financial year, is {certifiedIncome}.

This certificate is issued for the purpose of {purpose}, on the basis of the documents filed by the applicant and the field verification report of the Talathi, Saja {village}.
certificate.validity: This certificate is valid for the current financial year from the date of issue.

metrics.title: Impact metrics
metrics.intro: These figures are computed from this system's own records. In a pilot they should be compared against the figures in the current registers for the same months.

help.avgDays: From the day the application arrives to the day it is decided. This is the citizen's actual wait.
help.withinSla: The share decided inside the Right to Public Services deadline.
help.returnRate: The share of applications that went back to the applicant at least once. A return at scrutiny is cheap; a return after the field visit is expensive.
help.rework: Files sent back to scrutiny or out for re-verification. This shows the quality of the first pass.
help.aiAgreement: Of the actions taken with a suggestion on screen, how often it was accepted. Too low means the rules need fixing; 100% could mean the suggestion is being accepted without thought.

metrics.overrides: Decisions that differed from the assistant
metrics.noOverrides: No decision has gone against the assistant yet.
metrics.noData: There are not enough records yet for these figures.
